title: Agent harness project configuration
description: Project-specific facts used by Claude Code settings, hooks, CI, slash commands and Slack notifications. This file holds facts only; it must not contain profiles, modes or customer/internal switches.

approvers.description: GitHub handles (without @) who approve design memos and pull requests. At least one is required before /plan and /implement will run.

target.description: Where production is deployed, e.g. "cloudflare-workers", "vercel", "aws-ecs". Free text; used in docs and notifications.

productionBranch.description: Branch whose merge triggers a production deploy, e.g. "main".

productionPatterns.description: Regular expressions (JavaScript syntax) that identify production hosts, URLs or environment names. Any Bash command matching one of these is blocked by the PreToolUse hook.

maxMinutes.description: GitHub Actions timeout-minutes for Claude jobs.

maxParallel.description: Maximum number of subagents allowed to run at the same time. Enforced by the PreToolUse hook on the Agent tool, which reserves a slot per call and releases it on SubagentStop.

maxDepth.description: How deep subagent nesting may go. 1 means the main conversation may spawn subagents but those subagents may not spawn their own.

bestOfN.description: Number of independent attempts to run when Best-of-N triggers (two consecutive test failures, or blocking findings surviving two fix attempts). Never used outside those conditions: there is no setting that turns it on permanently.

protectedPaths.description: Glob patterns (gitignore-like: a pattern without "/" matches at any depth) that Claude Code may read but not write. Changes to these paths are made by humans through pull requests. Must include ".mcp.json".

secretPaths.description: Glob patterns for files that may contain secrets. Claude Code may neither read nor write them (including via cat, sed, redirects).

commands.description: Shell commands run by hooks, CI and /verify. "{file}" is replaced with the edited file path when present; otherwise the command runs against the whole project. An empty string means "not configured" and the step is skipped with a note.

servers.description: Names of servers from .mcp.json that are enabled for this project. Must match keys in .mcp.json.

envRefs.description: Per server: names (not values) of environment variables the server needs.

channel.description: Slack channel ID (e.g. C0123456789). Empty string disables all notifications.

mentionApprovers.description: Mention approvers on events that need a human decision (plan.ready, escalation, pr.opened with blocking findings).

approverSlackIds.description: Optional map of GitHub handle -> Slack member ID (U…), used for mentions. Handles without an entry are shown as plain text.

tokenSecretName.description: Name of the GitHub Actions secret that holds the Slack bot token. The value is never stored here.

agents.description: Model tier per role. The subagent definitions in .claude/agents/ deliberately omit `model`, so this file is the only place a tier is decided; the caller passes it as the Agent tool's `model` parameter and the PreToolUse hook rejects a call that does not match.

model.description: Model tier for the planner role. Must be a value the Agent tool accepts.

role.description: What this role does. Documentation only; nothing reads it at runtime.

model.description: Model tier for the implementer role. Must be a value the Agent tool accepts.
